scope: independent root audit of the reversed terminal-normalized sums, 3-adic unit structure, primitive actual-family overcarriers, unreduced holonomicity, selector-mass comparison, capacity, and zero booking

mathematical_audit.reversal: Palindromy of both kernels and (a-r)_r=(-1)^r(1-a)_r give the stated reversed sums for x_h=X_h/T_h and u_h=U_h/S_(h+2).
mathematical_audit.three_adic_unit: The r=0 term is one, while the r-th correction has 3-adic valuation at least r. Hence both normalized values lie in 1+3Z_3 for every 3 not dividing h.
mathematical_audit.clearing: Multiplying each prefix denominator by the full linear-factor product gives the exact integral A_x/D_x and A_u/D_u formulas. Modulo three only the r=0 term remains, so numerator and denominator are 3-units before and after primitive reduction.
mathematical_audit.actual_bridge: Every clearing and terminal factor has absolute value at most 4h+3, while the actual prime is at least 4h+9. All denominators and terminal factors are p-units, proving the exact one-coordinate numerator equivalences.
mathematical_audit.holonomicity_scope: On each h mod 3 class the unreduced finite sums are proper hypergeometric and therefore P-recursive. Nonlinear gcd reduction does not inherit this conclusion, and no recurrence for N_x or N_u is claimed.
mathematical_audit.comparison: C_h=(product over 4h<k<=18h, 3 not dividing k)^2 is integral, congruent to one mod three, has O(h log h) height, and satisfies an explicit first-order h-to-h+3 recurrence.
mathematical_audit.selector_mass: For 4M/3<p<=35M/24, h=3M-2p lies in the declared bulk and p divides C_h. The prime number theorem gives Chebyshev mass M/8+o(M), or 1/48 per 6M.
mathematical_audit.scope_warning: The comparison is not the actual carrier and supplies no lower bound for it. It only proves that recurrence, integrality, 3-adic unit normalization, and pointwise height alone cannot yield selector zero density.
mathematical_audit.capacity: The primitive one-coordinate carriers overcover paired boundary gates and cannot be booked separately. The shared 1/36 ceiling remains unchanged.
